name: silhouette-group-collage
title_zh: 把合影剪成正负形双联画，人像像素级锁定
tagline_zh: 老照片翻新怕丢脸？它用正负形互锁，原人像像素级保留，配纸纹、手写字和手绘星，把青春记忆做成能挂墙的上下双联画。
tagline_en: Old group photos losing faces? It locks original pixels with reciprocal masks, adds paper grain, handwriting &.
desc_en: Frozen v1 baseline for transforming user-supplied group photos into vertical diptych silhouette collages using reciprocal positive-negative masks, source-pixel-locked original people, tactile paper fields, preserved film texture, scene-matched handwriting, and sparse handmade stars. Use when the user asks for 剪影群像风格, 剪影群像风格 v1, silhouette group collage, 群像剪影拼贴, 正负形镜空, 上下双联画, youth-memory group art
why_zh: 不是滤镜叠加，是几何级正负形互锁：每张脸都从原图抠出、像素级锚定，纸纹与胶片颗粒分层保留。
why_en: Not a filter—geometric reciprocal masks anchor every face from the source at pixel level. Paper & film grain stay layered.
limit_zh: 只吃单人或多人的合影原图，且要求人物轮廓清晰可抠；输出固定为上下双联画竖版，不做横版或三联。超出此构图或轮廓模糊时。
limit_en: Only accepts group photos with clear, extractable silhouettes; output is fixed vertical diptych—no horizontal or triptych. If contours are blurry or.
